correctness.rationale: Over a splitting field for the Fourier polynomial, the normalized Fourier basis satisfies \(w_a w_b=w_{-a}\) exactly when \(b=-2a\). Leibniz applied to each vanishing product forces every off-diagonal Fourier coefficient to vanish. Descending translation commutation gives all derivations as circulant matrices; coefficient comparison proves the exact \(c(-u)=-c(u)\) and \(c(u)=2c(2u)\) conditions and their converse. The action of <2,-1> on elements of additive order d has orbit size \(h_d\), with a free scalar precisely when the two stated modular relations hold. This proves the dimension formula for all eligible n and fields. A standalone independent equation system over prime fields agreed in 68 coprime-characteristic cases; the explicit order-11 characteristic-3 map passed 1331 Leibniz coefficient comparisons. These calculations are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The principal 2021 source establishes general coefficient equations, zero derivations for odd n in characteristic zero, and a positive-characteristic table only for orders three through six. It does not state the uniform coprime-positive-characteristic orbit criterion or its smallest nonzero example at order eleven and characteristic three. The 2023 dihedral group-conjugation-quandle thesis concerns a different object; the 2024 decomposition article treats even n over R and C. No dominating theorem surfaced in targeted literature and mathematical-record searches, though equivalence elsewhere remains possible.
residual_risks: Other finite-characteristic quandle-algebra derivation papers may contain equivalent orbit counts under a different presentation. The targeted searches are not a proof of bibliographic uniqueness.
The 2024 even-order real/complex decomposition paper was not read in full; its stated scope makes direct coverage unlikely.

value.rationale: The derivation Lie algebra is a standard intrinsic algebraic invariant. The theorem classifies it over an infinite natural family by an explicit arithmetic criterion, and identifies a first unexpected nonzero coprime-characteristic example at order eleven in characteristic three, despite vanishing in characteristic zero. Exact vector-space dimensions and finite-field counts follow uniformly, giving a motivated boundary rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
